{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter to only completed orders (non-refunded)
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
completed_orders['revenue_numeric'] = completed_orders['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders as those with revenue >= 999999.00
qa_threshold = 999999.00
qa_in_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_numeric'] >= qa_threshold]

print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue >= 999999.00): {len(qa_in_completed)}")
print(f"QA order details: {qa_in_completed[['order_id', 'revenue', 'revenue_numeric', 'status', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age']]}" )

# Remove QA orders
valid_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_numeric'] < qa_threshold]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue_corrected = valid_completed['revenue_numeric'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of valid completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue_corrected}")

# Final count
num_valid_completed = len(valid_completed)
print(f"Number of valid completed orders: {num_valid_completed}")"}
